prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change



## Context of Change



Move the implementations of the confidential transfer test helpers out of
`src/test/jtx/ConfidentialTransfer.h` and into
`src/test/jtx/impl/ConfidentialTransfer.cpp`. Test-only refactor; no
production code or transaction behavior changes.

- Comment fixes:
  - `getForgedBulletproof`: removed an incorrect "returns 1 on success, 0 on
    failure" note (it returns a `Buffer` and throws on failure).
  - `getForgedConvertBackProof`: the bulletproof is built from
    `realBalance - amt`, not `realBalance`; clarified which inputs are
    on-ledger.
  - `ConfidentialEnv`: now describes what the constructor actually does.
  - `getTrivialSendProofHex`: added a comment.
- Removed the unused `ConfidentialSendSetup::nRecipients` member.


## API Impact



- [ ] Public API: New feature (new methods and/or new fields)
- [ ] Public API: Breaking change (in general, breaking changes should only impact the next api_version)
- [ ] `libxrpl` change (any change that may affect `libxrpl` or dependents of `libxrpl`)
- [ ] Peer protocol change (must be backward compatible or bump the peer protocol version)
